title: iPhone lab review: while the phone record is unreadable, the review cannot check for an already-saved document and may offer one as new; the save itself is refused. Option: refuse to open a review while store.problem is set.
evidence: After a failed phone read RecordStore.recordJSON is "" (US-25 AC11p, PR 1408). The lab review's dedup reads it (ios/HealthRoadmap/LabUpload/LabReviewView.swift:188, LabReportSave.swift:187), so it reviews against no record: unchecked whether the engine then throws or finds nothing already saved. The save is refused with the problem's words (RecordStore+Uploads.swift importLabsInTurn and saveDocumentInTurn; UnreadableRecordTests.testALabImportOnAnUnreadableRecordGivesTheProblemsWords_US25_AC11p). Found in PR 1408 (lead S27)
